title: Draft the technical design in the Plan
statement: As an architect, I can draft the technical design for a change in its Plan, and break it into the Tasks that carry it out, so the design and the work to do it stay in one place.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A Plan's deck and essay can hold the technical design for its change before any of that code exists.
A Plan's slides can reference the Tasks that carry out the design they describe.
